en: Black‑and‑white landscape view taken from a terraced vineyard looking down over a European river city. In the foreground are orderly rows of vines supported by stakes. Beyond them lies a dense old town on both riverbanks. A multi‑span stone bridge with several arches crosses the wide river. On the hill to the left dominates a large fortified complex with walls, towers, and at least one tall church spire, overlooking the town and river valley.
